problems: Korean district names were romanised (korean-romanizer + manual fixes for nasal assimilation: Jongno, Jungnang, Gangneung, Ulleung, Dongnae) and matched to geoBoundaries ADM2 within the province (province assigned to each ADM2 shape by largest overlap with ADM1), or by a nationally unique name. The geoBoundaries KOR ADM2 layer (2020, citypopulation.de) is of uneven quality (inconsistent names, Yeonggwang missing). 대구 군위군 and 경북 군위군 both map to the single Gunwi-gun shape (Gunwi moved from Gyeongbuk to Daegu in July 2023). KOSIS (Statistics Korea) tables need an API key or interactive session and were not used.
